security_audit.summary: The static analyzer flagged Markdown fences, inline examples, a read-only git diff command, and sample environment-variable code as risky patterns. These are instructional examples for a code review skill, not executable skill logic or secret access. No evidence found for prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent.

remediation.issue: The documentation uses a realistic fake API key in an example.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the sample key with an obvious placeholder such as EXAMPLE_API_KEY to reduce scanner noise.

remediation.issue: The usage guide includes a shell command with command substitution.
remediation.suggestion: State that the git diff command is read-only and should run only in the target repository.

content.user_title: Review Code for Quality and Security
content.value_statement: Code changes often hide bugs, security flaws, and maintainability risks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through structured reviews with prioritized findings.
actual_capabilities: Reviews git diffs and modified files for code quality issues.
Checks for hardcoded secrets, missing validation, and unsafe input handling.
Organizes feedback into critical issues, warnings, and suggestions.
Uses reference checklists for security, performance, testing, and documentation.
Produces review notes with file locations, impact, and recommended fixes.
limitations: It relies on available repository context and may miss hidden runtime behavior.
It does not replace dedicated scanners or human security review.
It may need project conventions from the user for style decisions.
Example commands require a local git repository.

use_cases.title: Pre-merge Review
use_cases.description: Review branch changes before merging and identify bugs, regressions, and missing tests.

use_cases.title: Security-focused Audit
use_cases.description: Check changed code for secrets, unsafe input handling, authorization gaps, and risky data flows.

use_cases.title: Team Quality Standard
use_cases.description: Apply a consistent review checklist across repositories and teach maintainable coding habits.

prompt_templates.title: Review Recent Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a local branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the recent changes in this branch. Prioritize security bugs, breaking changes, and missing tests.

prompt_templates.title: Review One File
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review for a specific file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this file for security, readability, error handling, and maintainability. Include exact locations and suggested fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request as a senior engineer. Separate critical issues, warnings, and suggestions. Explain impact for each item.

prompt_templates.title: Deep Security Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a security-focused review of the changed authentication and data access code. Check input validation, authorization, secrets, logging, and abuse cases.

output_examples.output: A summary lists files reviewed, critical issues, warnings, and suggestions. Each issue includes location, impact, and a recommended fix.

output_examples.input: Review an authentication file for security risks.
output_examples.output: The review highlights exposed secrets, missing validation, and authorization concerns. It separates must-fix items from lower-priority improvements.
The response identifies duplicated logic, unclear names, missing error handling, and test gaps. It recommends small, concrete improvements.

best_practices: Provide the relevant diff, files, and project conventions before starting the review.
Ask for critical issues first when time is limited.
Verify suggested fixes with tests or project maintainers before merging.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad reviews without sharing changed files or context.
Do not treat generated review notes as a replacement for security testing.
Do not request style-only feedback when the change handles authentication or sensitive data.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews code changes for security, bugs, maintainability, performance, testing, and project standards.

faq.question: Can it review a full pull request?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the branch diff, pull request summary, and any project rules for best results.

faq.question: Does it run security scanners?
faq.answer: No. It guides AI review and checklist-based analysis. Use scanners for dependency and static analysis coverage.

faq.question: Can Claude Code and Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect prioritized findings with locations, impact, rationale, and practical fix guidance.

faq.question: Is it useful for security-only reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for a security-focused review and include authentication, authorization, input handling, and data flow context.
